about: Who holds which part of the battery RAM stock leaves free (0x100f859c-0x100fff00): it keeps its contents through a power cycle. Ranges are [from, to). sdk/tests/test_battery_ram.py checks that no two overlap, and that every address the base, a module or a draft names in that span lies in a range here: the base's in any range (it reads the others' records), a module's or draft's in one its owner (the folder's name) holds. The base's per-module store is planned, not built (docs/OCTATRACK_API.md, Keeping state); a range here is how a module keeps settings through a power cycle until then.

ranges.what: 'KCS1': which Kit each of the 64 Part slots holds, and a sum that starts from the project's id
'PMNV': each pattern's play mode, 256 rows of 9 bytes and a 16-bit sum
settings.c's 'MWS1': the choice kept for each of eight module settings (PROJ > MODWERK > SETTINGS), by the hash of its label
setting_presets.h MWP1 stores panel overrides for up to 32 imported module presets
status.c's 'MWER': what each measured module adds to the frame share in use, on waking and at rest, from the site's last MWMS v2 set (set_package.h)
diag.c's 'MWLR': the lateness of the last eight frame-interrupt entries before a stall, as the late-entry wait measured them (machine_registry.c)
'SCS2': the current bank's MIDI scene locks, packed (magic, bank, count, sum, project id, then one long a lock)
each of the 256 patterns' Kit, under the sum at 0x100f85a0
fxmap.c's map of module effect handles
diag.c's trace of the frames before a stall
modset.c's 'MWAD' (development bases only, dev.c's ADOPT TEST): restore another base's card set, and write none
machine_registry.c's map of the machines a project uses (MWMC, 16 entries of 24 bytes)
